prompt.en: In which city does the Royal Canadian Mounted Police have its training academy?
prompt.fr: Dans quelle ville la Gendarmerie royale du Canada a-t-elle son académie de formation?

explanation.en: The training academy of the Mounted Police is in Regina, the capital of Saskatchewan.
explanation.fr: L'académie de formation de la Gendarmerie royale du Canada se trouve à Regina, la capitale de la Saskatchewan.

source.quote: Regina, the capital, is home to the training academy of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police.
